clue.text: An edict's amended to effect separation

indicators.note: amended means altered, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A ruling is revised so that two parties are kept apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Distance is the gap or space keeping two things apart, a synonym for separation.

clue.text: The lawlessness of the underworld class

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, and his realm
an order is a class or rank, as in biology

explanation.surface: Crime among the gangland fraternity.
explanation.walkthrough: Dis, the Roman ruler of the dead, stands for the underworld in crosswords; 'The' and 'of' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Disorder is a breakdown of public peace and law, a synonym for lawlessness.

parts.note: a man who fights is a scrapper, and his book of records would be a scrapper's book; the real thing is an album of cuttings

explanation.surface: A soldier keeps a journal.
explanation.definitionFit: A cuttings album kept as a personal record, reinterpreted as the book of someone who scraps.

clue.text: Painter turning on a boy for lighting up

indicators.note: turning means the painter's letters are flipped round to read the other way

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is a painter
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: An artist rounds on a lad caught smoking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lighting up' suggests a cigarette, but here it means setting fire to things deliberately.
explanation.definitionFit: Arson is the crime of deliberately setting property alight, a cryptic reading of lighting up.

indicators.note: being made suggests the letters are formed into something new, an anagram signal

explanation.surface: Someone panics on being promoted to lead the team.
explanation.definitionFit: A skipper is the commander of a ship or team, a synonym.

clue.text: Returning without reason before time, appears hurt

indicators.note: returning means the word for crazy is read back the other way

parts.note: someone without reason is mad
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone coming back irrationally before the hour looks injured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without reason' reads like 'for no reason' but is a synonym for crazy; 'Returning' turns that round and 'appears' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Damage is harm or injury done, a synonym for hurt as a noun.

clue.text: Bill: made certain demands would be honoured

parts.note: AC, account, is a bill
claimed means asserted a right or demanded

explanation.surface: A man named Bill insisted his demands be respected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a man's name but stands for an account, AC; 'would be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Acclaimed means praised publicly, close to honoured.

definitions.meaning: a-wing means on the wing, in flight

explanation.definitionFit: On the wing describes flight; to awe is to intimidate, so both senses fit.

parts.note: a number written as the digit 1 twice in a row

explanation.surface: A number that keeps being handed out.
explanation.definitionFit: The number 11 is written with the digit for one given twice.

clue.text: Dawdle, and find somebody maybe throwing things!

definitions.meaning: to dawdle is to dither about idly
a ceramicist throws pots on a wheel

explanation.surface: An idler is found hurling objects about.
explanation.definitionFit: To potter is to dawdle about; a potter shapes or throws clay on a wheel.

clue.text: The school-head remains to take classes

indicators.note: head means the first letter of the word school is taken

parts.note: orts are scraps or leftovers of food

explanation.surface: The headmaster stays behind to teach lessons.
explanation.walkthrough: ORTS, an old word for leftovers, is a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorts are kinds or types, a synonym for classes.

parts.note: someone who is not an amateur is a pro, a professional
a scribe is a writer or copyist

explanation.surface: A professional author is condemned outright.
explanation.definitionFit: To proscribe is to condemn or forbid, close to damning.

parts.note: re means about or concerning
pent means shut up or confined
an ant is a social insect and a worker

explanation.surface: Apologising regarding a jailed welfare officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' suggests a welfare professional, but it is an ant, a social insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Repentant means feeling remorse, a synonym for sorry.

clue.text: Drop a line, giving point of view

definitions.meaning: to fish with rod and line
a slant or perspective on something

explanation.definitionFit: To angle is to fish; an angle is a perspective on a matter.

indicators.note: becomes signals the letters turn into something else, an anagram

explanation.surface: Anger quickly grows tiresome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wearing' looks like an adjective meaning tiring, but it is the noun sense of wearing away.
explanation.definitionFit: Erosion is the gradual wearing away of rock or soil.

definitions.meaning: a guerrilla fighter outside the regular army

explanation.definitionFit: An irregular is a guerrilla soldier; irregular also means uneven or bumpy.

parts.note: an adjournment in the course of a court case, sending the accused back to custody until the trial resumes

explanation.surface: An irritating pause.
explanation.definitionFit: A court sending a prisoner back into custody while a case is adjourned is a pause in trying them.

clue.text: Wild lionesses not making a sound

indicators.note: wild signals the letters run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: Untamed big cats stalking in silence.
explanation.definitionFit: Noiseless means silent, making no sound at all.

clue.text: A man of straw, but as a worker topping!

definitions.text: A man of straw, but as a worker topping!

parts.words: A man of straw, but as a worker topping!
parts.note: a craftsman who works with straw and puts it on top of houses, so his work is a topping

explanation.surface: A weak figure who is nevertheless an excellent employee.
explanation.definitionFit: A roofer who uses straw or reeds literally deals in straw and works on roof tops.

definitions.meaning: to skirt is to pass round the edge of
garments worn hanging from the waist

explanation.definitionFit: To skirt is to circle the edge; skirts are garments.
To spring is to leap; a spring is a natural water source.

indicators.note: in means the minister and one are placed inside the money

parts.note: cash is money
DD, Doctor of Divinity, is a minister of religion
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A dishonourable clergyman is rich.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the money' looks like 'rich', but 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Caddish describes the behaviour of a cad, a man who is no gentleman.

parts.note: CO, company, is a firm
piers are supporting pillars

explanation.surface: A company props up its office kit.
explanation.definitionFit: Copiers are photocopying machines found in offices.

clue.text: Property among the best — a tenant's dream

indicators.note: among says the letters lie inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Housing among the finest, which renters dream of.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate is land or property owned by someone.

parts.note: S, south, is a compass bearing
a prig is a self-righteous prude

explanation.surface: A young person carrying himself like a prude.
explanation.walkthrough: A sprig is an old word for a young man.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprig is a lad, a young offshoot of a family, so a youngster.

parts.note: RA, Royal Artillery, are gunmen
a bat is a club

explanation.surface: Armed men band together in North Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'club together' suggests pooling money, but club is a bat and 'together' a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Rabat is the capital city of Morocco, so a place found there.

clue.text: A break without exercise left the Continental decidedly unpleasant

indicators.note: without means outside, so the break goes around the other pieces

parts.note: a rent is a tear or break
PE is physical exercise
L is left
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Taking a break without working out left the European thoroughly disagreeable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but means outside here, and 'the Continental' is French for 'the'; the opening 'A' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Repellent means causing disgust, so very disagreeable.

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral fifty
a is the indefinite article
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: The artist Turner has penned fifty essays.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turner's' suggests the painter, but it reads as 'turner is': the machine that turns wood.
explanation.definitionFit: A lathe is the machine that spins wood or metal for shaping, so a turner.

clue.text: One needs to be patient to use such transport

definitions.text: One needs to be patient to use such transport

parts.words: One needs to be patient to use such transport
parts.note: patient here means a person under medical care, not someone who waits calmly

explanation.surface: This vehicle requires calm passengers.
explanation.definitionFit: An emergency vehicle that carries the sick, so its riders are patients.

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: damaged means the letters of the word are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: Observe the broken gear wheels.
explanation.definitionFit: The projections on a gear wheel are its cogs, or teeth.

clue.text: Blackmail that's no longer wrong in the eyes of the law

parts.note: ex means former, no longer

parts.words: wrong in the eyes of the law
parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law

explanation.surface: Coercion that is not illegal any more.
explanation.definitionFit: To extort is to obtain money by threats, as a blackmailer does.

parts.note: asses are fools or blockheads
R is right

explanation.surface: A man judges fools, and quite correctly.
explanation.definitionFit: An assessor values property or sets rates for tax.
